title: HaloITSM Review (2026)
intro: HaloITSM is evaluated here as an IT service management (ITSM) / employee service desk platform — HaloITSM (Halo) is an all-in-one ITSM / employee service-desk platform (incidents, requests, assets, and adjacent PSA-style packaging) from Halo Service Solutions. The first-party UK pricing calculator shows about £66/agent/month billed annually as the published all-in-one floor — treat as GBP, not a USD list. Onboarding packages are extra. Same itsm-service-desk cluster as ServiceNow and Freshservice — this entity does not outrank ServiceNow 8.7 or Freshservice 8.4. Distinct from SysAid’s quote-led ~$89 listing and from ManageEngine’s $13 Standard floor. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s IT & Development methodology (ease of use, IT job fit, workflow depth, integrations, admin/security, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose HaloITSM when all-in-one per-agent ITSM with a published UK calculator is the job — not ServiceNow by default, and not Freshservice by default.
verdict: Choose HaloITSM when all-in-one per-agent ITSM with a published UK calculator is the job — not ServiceNow by default, and not Freshservice by default. Compare ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus for a USD $13 floor; Freshservice for the mid-market award path; SysAid if you prefer that automation suite. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, host/GB rates and minimums on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: All-in-one per-agent packaging is easier to model than SysAid quotes; UK calculator is the learning tax for USD buyers. Not a lab test.
ITSM / service desk — same cluster as Freshservice and ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus, not a PSA-only or observability SKU.
All-in-one ITSM (and adjacent PSA-style) workflows are deep for the job; still below ServiceNow CMDB/ESM.
Slack/Teams/API cover typical desks; Halo marketplace is not Atlassian’s.
Paid all-in-one admin is solid for mid-market; not ServiceNow domain separation.
Per-agent annual ladder plus onboarding; held at 8, below ServiceNow’s 10.
Published £66 annual calculator is clearer than SysAid quotes; GBP vs USD and onboarding extras are the TCO catch. Affiliate economics excluded.
Halo AI assist exists — scored as supporting, not a reason to skip Freshservice or ServiceNow.
